description:
Cast Black Panther either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Black Panther enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a land you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Black Panther trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a land you control.
Repeat from step 3.
